insert_family: M2.5 ruthex RX-M2.5x5.7 or equivalent 4.6 mm OD x 5.7 mm long heat-set insert

notes.layout: Follows latest transparent sketch: portrait board left; vertical lever connector right with four-port end above the centerline; both lever holes and lower PCB pair on Y=95.9. Smaller left branch carries upper PCB pair. Main horizontal/vertical cross are geometrically centered.
notes.orientation: Original rear photo rotated 180 degrees; panel power is at upper right, HUB75 input at lower left. Board component side outward, USB/buttons at bottom, HUB75 at top. This is a 90 degree rotation from rev2 drawing view.
notes.frame: 12 mm wide border, 10 mm wide main cross and 8 mm wide left PCB branch are all 4 mm thick. Only six local insert bosses reach Z=8 mm. All four factory corner inserts have 25 mm radial print-material clearance.
notes.inserts: M2.5 identifies thread, not a universal insert body. This model explicitly uses a common 4.6 OD / 5.7 length family, 4.0 pilot, 6.7 blind depth. Confirm with provided coupon; change parameter if actual inserts differ. No captured hex nuts.
notes.board_inset: Prior 23 mm inset retained on the left side in this rotated layout, relative to approximately 12.7 mm inner frame edge inferred from drawing.
notes.lever: 19 mm ear-hole pitch supplied by user. Both holes exactly on frame centerline. 13.5 interpreted as body height. 42 x 26 footprint and 5 mm ear-axis/body-center offset from similar reference remain approximate.
